page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ae.large is a general-purpose instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at 3.4 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 1 physical core with 2 threads per core. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB per core. It has no local storage and does not include a GPU. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a divergence between single-core and multi-core performance. The instance demonstrates strong single-core capabilities, with a stress-ng single-core CPU score of 3111.39 and a Geekbench single-core score of 2006.0, both placing in the top 25%. However, multi-core and parallelized workloads show limitations; the multi-core Geekbench score of 2501.0 and multi-core stress-ng score of 3112.08 fall into the bottom 25%. Memory performance is moderate, with large-block read-only bandwidth at 47.71 GB/sec and write bandwidth at 27.73 GB/sec.

Given the lack of local storage and poor performance in database operations and static web serving throughput, this instance is less suited for high-throughput web hosting or heavy database deployments. It is best utilized for lightweight general-purpose workloads, single-threaded processing tasks, or utility services that benefit from dedicated CPU allocation and strong single-core execution without requiring high multi-threaded density.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ae.large is a general-purpose instance featuring 2 dedicated vCPUs and 8.0 GB of RAM, powered by an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor operating at 3.4 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this KVM-hypervised server allocates 4.0 GB of memory per core across its single physical core. It lacks local storage and GPU accelerators, relying on a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps. Performance benchmarks highlight strong single-core capabilities, with Geekbench and stress-ng single-core scores in the top 25%. Conversely, multi-core performance, database operations, and static web serving throughput are weak to poor. Consequently, this instance is best suited for lightweight, single-threaded applications, basic utility tasks, and general-purpose workloads that do not require high multi-threaded throughput or local storage.
